matters:
Technology stocks bounced on Friday after Thursday’s sell-off, giving a mixed close: the S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose while the Dow slipped. The S&P 500 trimmed its weekly loss, per the 6 Nov report.

The Nasdaq remains below Thursday’s starting level by a wide margin; one Friday rebound does not settle whether the correction is over.
